title: feat(studio): ⌘K on every Studio design page lists the package's menu and items
body:
Fixes #36900
Part of #36890
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYkkwuF6UuFtu85Yd5H

## 维护者速读

- 在 Studio 的任何设计页面(包括「全部元数据」跨包页)按 ⌘K / Ctrl+K,都能打开搜索面板:按左侧菜单的六组列出当前包的全部类型和每一项,选中即打开它的详情或设计器。
- 属于「Studio 重构」专题:去掉设计器左侧那一列后,作者靠 ×、‹ › 和 ⌘K 换到别的项;同时补回上一步左侧菜单改造时临时丢掉的跨包页 ⌘K。
- 出错时作者只是搜不到或打不开某一项,左侧菜单和列表照常可用;不动任何数据,直接撤回这次改动即可。
- 无。

## What changes

**The command palette is mounted on every Studio design page** (`StudioDesignSurface`'s shell, under its own `CommandPaletteProvider`): a package's pillars and "All metadata" area, `~org` and `~all`. After #36985 only the `/studio` landing had one, so `~all` had lost ⌘K (the hand-off's stated temporary regression); this restores it.

- **What it lists on a package.** The left menu, group by group (`buildStudioMenu`, decision 11: Data, UI, Automation, Platform, Access, AI, under the menu's names). Each group holds the menu's own entries: each type's list, plus Organization flows, Default sharing, Diagnostics and Positions and permissions. Then come the items of every type the group lists, from the package and its `.custom` pair (ADR-0146 D3). The types come from the menu's own rule and reads (`scopeDirectoryEntries` over the registry entries and the diagnostics sweep), so the palette and the menu cannot disagree. The items come from each type's served list, the read its list page makes, scoped to the two packages and named by the type's primary key. Packages stay listed. On a package the palette no longer lists every package's objects and flows, because the package's own items replace them. `~org` and `~all` keep those lists and add their own menu entries.
- **Where a pick opens.** Every address comes from `studioAddress.ts` (#36895). An object, flow or permission set goes through `studioItemPath`, so it opens its designer today and follows each designer card's `STUDIO_ITEM_PILLAR` switch with no edit here. Any other item opens `studioMetadataItemAddress(…, ?package=OWNER)`, the address its list row links to (ADR-0048). A menu entry goes to the menu entry's own `to`.
- **How it leaves (decision 12).** The page opens what the palette picks (`StudioPaletteSurface.open`). Another page: it asks about unsaved work (`confirmLeavePillar`), then goes. The page already open on another query (Default sharing from the Access pillar): it asks, then remounts the pillar on the new query through the menu's own re-entry (`reenterPillar`), because a pillar reads its deep link once. The page already shown, palette keys aside: the palette just closes. The decision is the pure `studioPaletteDeparture`.
- **The palette stays free of Studio reads.** `CommandPalette`'s `studio` scope takes an optional `surface` (`packageScope`, `renderGroups`, `open`). The page draws its own groups (`StudioPaletteGroups`), so the menu model and the metadata reads load with the Studio chunk, never with the console's eager closure. The groups mount only while the palette is open, so nothing is read until ⌘K. `@object-ui/app-shell` is private, so the new optional prop and exported types widen no published surface: `Clause-②: no`.
- **Card item 1 (`advertisedShortcuts.ts`)** needs no edit. `CommandPaletteProvider` already advertises ⌘K (`useAdvertiseShortcut(OPEN_COMMAND_PALETTE_SHORTCUT)`), and it now runs on every design page.
- **Card item 4 (#35308)**: the studio scope searches no record, so it has no record title. Items are titled by their served metadata label, as their lists show them, and no second title rule exists.

New modules: `studio-design/studioPaletteModel.ts` (pure: packages, items, addresses, groups, departure) and `studio-design/StudioPaletteGroups.tsx` (reads and draws). `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` changes only in its shell region: the provider, the palette mount, and `openFromPalette` beside `reenterPillar`. `StudioRoute.tsx` is unchanged, because the builder route already renders the surface. No i18n key is added: the palette reuses the menu's strings and the pack's `Searching…`.

Read first, by risk:
1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`: the `openFromPalette` / `paletteSurface` hunk and the provider wrap. This is the only edit to a shared file.
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioPaletteGroups.tsx`: the read gating (`settled`, `useStudioPaletteItems`) and the loading hand-back.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/chrome/CommandPalette.tsx`: `surface`, `openStudio`, and `useStudioPaletteEntries(…, crossPackageItems)`.

## Tests

- New `studioPaletteModel-36900.test.ts` (11 cases). It pins the package and its `.custom` pair; items unwrapped, scoped, deduped and named by the type's primary key, with the type's list predicate applied; pillar types following `studioItemPath` for every `STUDIO_ITEM_PILLAR` row; other types on their area page with `?package=OWNER`; the menu's six groups in order with each item under its type's group and none outside the menu; and the leave / re-enter / stay decision, with the palette's own keys and query order ignored.
- New `StudioPaletteGroups.surfaceScope-36900.test.tsx` (10 cases), driving the real `CommandPalette` + `CommandPaletteProvider` + `StudioPaletteGroups` with the metadata reads doubled at the menu's own seam. It pins group headings and order (the empty AI group left out); menu entries; the items of the package and its pair (another package's object and the datasource left out); no cross-package object or flow read or listed on a package; item and entry addresses handed to `surface.open`, and the palette closing; matching by label, name, type and group; "Searching…" while a list is pending, then "No results"; nothing read until open, with its CONTROL; and on `~all`, the environment entries beside every package's objects and flows.
- `StudioDesignSurface.metadataArea-28561.test.tsx` gains one top-level `describe` (3 cases) on the real surface. Ctrl+K on a package pillar opens `?palette=1` with the menu's entries, and picking `type:flow` lands on the area's flow list with the palette closed and the menu entry current. Ctrl+K works on `~all` (the restored regression), with the environment menu and no package-only entry. A missing package has no menu, so its palette lists the packages.

## Acceptance notes

- **Browser walk-through: NOT MEASURED.** The card's acceptance asks for ⌘K finding and opening an object, flow, permission set, hook and dashboard in a self-built app and in HotCRM's Studio, walked with 3-1, 3-2 and 3-3. This run had no live stack. The shared box's lock queue ran 5 to 9 minutes per turn. The real-surface pins above drive the mount, Ctrl+K and a pick through the real router. The joint walk-through belongs to the epic's walk-through card (#36910, the e2e and walk-through close-out).
- **No search button in Studio's header.** Studio's own header draws no search trigger. ⌘K / Ctrl+K is the way in, per card item 1. The landing's `AppHeader` still draws one. A header trigger is a header-composition question (the full-screen header kit from #36892), not this card's.
- **Keyboard-shortcuts help.** `CommandPaletteProvider` advertises ⌘K on every design page now. The help dialog that lists advertised shortcuts is mounted only inside apps (`AppContent`), so inside Studio nothing lists it. This is an observation, not a defect class.
- **Read cost.** Each open of the palette on a package re-reads the registry types, the diagnostics sweep and one list per listed type: the same reads the menu and each list page make. The client shares only in-flight reads, so nothing is cached across opens. Draft-only items are not listed (published lists only), as on the landing palette. On `~all` the environment catalog's types are offered as lists, not item by item.
- **#36784 overlap.** `overlap-check.mjs` reports a textual conflict with paused #36784 in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`. That PR is built on the pre-split file: merging it with `origin/main` alone already conflicts in that file (3 blocks), whatever this branch does. Every push here ran the check: `origin/main: merges cleanly`.
- **Docs.** No hand-written page under `content/docs/` describes Studio's navigation today (#36899 added none either). The epic gives docs and skills to #36910.
- **Size.** This card has one PR: 1,129 changed lines (+1,120 / −9, 8 files), under the 3,000-line Tier H line.

## Verification

Two minutes: open any package in Studio (`/studio/PKG/data`), press ⌘K (Ctrl+K), type part of a dashboard's or hook's name, and press Enter. The palette lists the six menu groups and the item; Enter opens `/studio/PKG/metadata/TYPE/NAME?package=OWNER`. With an unsaved edit on the page, the leave prompt appears first.

<details><summary>Where to look in code</summary>

- Mount and departure: `StudioDesignSurfaceBody`'s `openFromPalette` and `paletteSurface`, beside `reenterPillar`. The provider wraps the surface's providers.
- Groups: `StudioPaletteGroups` (reads) over `buildStudioPaletteGroups` / `studioPaletteItemAddress` (pure).

</details>
